content_blocks.title: Access Permission & Date Picker UI Modal
content_blocks.content:
A software UI modal dialog is displayed with the following elements:
1. An error message in red: 'Enter a valid wallet address or email'
2. An 'Access permission' section with two role tabs: 'Contributor' and 'Viewer' (Viewer described as 'view-only access for confidential files'). Partially visible text mentions permissions to '& remove Contributors' and 'sfer Lab to a new owner'.
3. A calendar date picker showing November 2026, with November 18th, 2026 selected (shown in the input field at the bottom of the calendar).
4. Navigation buttons: 'Go back' and 'Review'.
5. A 'Read more on team roles' link in the top right.
This is entirely a software/platform UI element with no scientific or TRL-relevant content.
